name: Meeting
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - JANUARY 24, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated January 24, 2013. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated January 24, 2013 in the total amount of $7,058,829.66.
B.
Successor Agency dated January 24, 2013. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated January 24, 2013 in the total amount of $5,600,000.00.
8.
Approval of the Treasurer's Report for the period ending November 30, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Treasurer's Report for the period ending November 30, 2012.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of January 10, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 10, 2013.
End of Consent Calendar
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING THE SUBMITTAL OF AN APPLICATION FOR A GRANT FROM THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, BUREAU OF RECLAMATION FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A WATER WELL IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS. (COUNCIL)
waive further reading and adopt a resolution captioned: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVIGN THE SUBMITTAL OF AN APPLICATION FOR A GRANT FROM THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR, BUREAU OF RECLAMATION FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF A WATER WELL IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS.
B.
Consideration of change of City Council assignment to the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority (CAJPIA). (COUNCIL)
1. Accept the resignation of Mayor Edwards as the City Council's delegate to the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority (CAJPIA);
2. Consider the City Council's assignment of Councilmember Carol Chen to the CAJPIA, by designating her as the City's respresentative on the CAJPIA Board of Directors; and
3. Appoint Mayor Edwards as the Alternate for the remainder of the term.
11.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor's Office for signature.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
13.
Adjournment
